findings.title: Password-reset emails delayed ~20-30 min during batch onboarding morning rush
findings.description: During a batch onboarding of 23 new hires on a Monday morning, several employees requested password-reset emails within the same ten-minute window (triggered by an HR 'set up your account' email sent at 9am sharp) and the reset emails arrived 20-30 minutes late instead of immediately. Not everyone was affected — a couple received theirs fine — and everyone eventually got in with no permanent lockouts. Testing the customer's own account outside the rush delivered the reset instantly, suggesting the delay is tied to request volume/peak-hours congestion. This matches the catalogue issue describing reset emails queuing behind bulk sends during morning peak.
findings.quote: several of them told me the password-reset email just... didn't come. Or came way late.
findings.severity_reason: Delays self-resolve within ~30 minutes and everyone eventually logged in, but it visibly disrupted a live onboarding session for roughly half the room; a workaround (staggering invite waves) was offered.
findings.match_note: Same underlying symptom (reset emails queued/delayed up to 30 min during morning peak volume) as PROJ-142; different account but identical failure mode and scope.

findings.title: N/A - internal workaround suggestion, not a customer-raised request
findings.description: Priya (internal) proactively suggested staggering the HR 'set up your account' email into multiple waves to spread out reset requests and avoid the peak-hours congestion, as a stopgap while the underlying delay issue is checked. Marcus agreed it was a good idea and said he'd relay it to HR. This is a suggested mitigation for the reset-email delay issue already logged, not a separate customer ask.
findings.quote: If HR sends it in two or three waves fifteen minutes apart instead of one 9am blast, you spread the reset requests out
findings.severity_reason: Not a defect or feature request; it is a workaround tied to the reset-email delay finding.
findings.match_note: Directly tied to the password-reset delay issue at L30; filed as related workaround, not standalone.
